Vous n'êtes pas obligé d'arriver à l'ouverture de la compétition. Présentez-vous simplement à l'accueil au moins 30 minutes avant votre première épreuve ou avant le tutoriel si vous êtes débutant. Un t-shirt de la compétition est compris dans le coût de l'inscription. 

You do not have to arrive at the opening of the competition. Simply introduce yourself at the reception at least 30 minutes before your first event or before the tutorial if this is your first competition. A competition t-shirt is included in the registration fee. 

Je hoeft niet aanwezig te zijn vanaf het begin van de dag. Ten minste 30 minuten vóór je eerste onderdeel of vóór de introductie als dit je eerste wedstrijd is, is voldoende. Een wedstrijd t-shirt is inbegrepen in het inschrijfgeld.

items.information:
## Português

**Note que este campeonato possui APENAS modalidades vendadas.**

* O pagamento da inscrição deve ser feito antecipadamente, todas as instruções se encontram na aba de *inscrever-se* do campeonato.
* A inscrição **NÃO** será aceita até que o pagamento e o comprovante sejam enviados. Sem isso sua inscrição não será aprovada e você não poderá competir.

***A inscrição só será efetivada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento. Assim, as inscrições estarão limitadas aos 20 primeiros pagantes. Caso o número de inscritos exceda este limite, será usada uma lista de espera de acordo com a ordem do pagamento.***

--------------------

## English

**Please note that this competition ONLY has blindfolded events**

* The payment of the registration fee must be made in advance. All the relevant instructions can be found under the *register* tab.
* The registration **WILL NOT** be accepted until the payment is done and the receipt is sent. Otherwise, your registration will not be accepted and you will not be allowed to competed at the day of the competition.

***Registration will only be confirmed at the WCA website after payment confirmation. Thus, registrations will be limited to the first 20 payers. If the number of registrations exceeds this limit, a waiting list will be put in place ordered by de date of payment.***

This competition is not recommeded for new competitors. If you are a new competitor, we recommend registering for [Ajax First-Timers 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AjaxFirstTimers2022).

items.name: Koalafication Tauranga 2022
items.information:
This competition mostly features less frequently-held events, to give people a chance to qualify for the inaugural [Rubik's WCA Oceanic Championship](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OC2022#17318-qualification-requirements) being held in Melbourne this December. However all competitors are welcome, regardless of experience or skill, or whether or not you're planning to attend the Oceanic Championship.

There will be event-based time limits in place, to ensure we stay on schedule. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.
